name: Adesh Sharma
player_statement:
A complete player, Adesh Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 236 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 97*, with an average of 26.26 and a quick strike rate of 137.34. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 179 sixes and 535 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 672.0 overs, taking 253 wickets at an economy rate of 6.77. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
